area: the AI boost policies and AI learning
summary: The Serpent's pellet boost AI (PelletBoostAIPolicySO) gains a refuel action and pacing genes: at or under refuelBelowPellets it presses the cloak itself to lay a wall and refuel, coasts along it for refuelCoastSeconds, and paces a low tank. Off by default (refuelBelowPellets -1), so no shipped AI changes until a trained genome is promoted.
why: FINDINGS 23: the Serpent's tank runs dry by Regatta's third lap because the AI never refuels; the kit is untouched (a game mode never changes the vessel).
